description: A single OpenStack Nova server that boots the plexsphere broker's cloud-init document and registers as a plexsphere node.

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: Id of the Glance image the server boots from; the console lists the images the Cloud Credential's project can use.

parameters.name: flavorId
parameters.description: Id of the Nova flavor that sizes the server.

parameters.name: networkId
parameters.description: Id of the Neutron network the server's port attaches to, such as the private network an openstack-landing-zone of this Project composed.

parameters.name: availabilityZone
parameters.description: Name of the Nova availability zone the server is scheduled into; without it the cloud picks one.
